proves.claim: With a write-hold violation recorded in the last hour, pullboard status prints an alarm line naming the count and the worst move and its held ms; with none it prints no such line.

cli.io-commands-status.write-hold-alarm.why: Without it, a board write held over one second would raise no alarm on status and the slow writer would go unseen.

proves.claim: status --json carries the same write-hold count under writeHoldAlarm.

cli.io-commands-status.write-hold-alarm-.why: Without it, a machine reader of status could not see the write-hold alarm the text shows.
